presentation.description: Simulates a full-length fight for your job using your own gear or a best-in-slot preset, then reports the DPS and shows exactly where it came from. Compares gear, melds and consumables, checks your openers and burst windows, and analyses an FFLogs report against the simulated ceiling. Kills on supported encounters can be scored and submitted to per-job leaderboards.
presentation.summary: Simulate your rotation, then see how your real kills measure up.

variant.author: jFray
variant.changelog: Ninja was losing an ability every cycle. A weave was refused whenever it came off cooldown during an animation lock, so the window went unused - worth about 0.7% of the job's damage. Ninja scores on the leaderboards have been rescored against the corrected ceiling.
